newsitem.title: USA: BPA widens expansion power to peak hours at $9/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA widens expansion power to peak hours at $9/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) widened its offer of "market expansion" power for Northwest deliveries only to include some peak demand hours at $9.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Wednesday.
BPA also offered off-peak market expansion power at $7.00 for both the Southwest and Northwest, down from $9.00 for Tuesday.
The agency continued to offer peak and off-peak power for firm and non-firm sales, with peak volumes limited to 500 megawatts.
Thursday firm power during off-peak hours was unchanged at $10.50 per MWh for all deliveries. Peak power was offered at $16.25, down from Wednesday prices.
Prices for Thursday non-firm power during off-peak hours were also slightly lower at $10.50-11.50 per MWh, while on-peak offers fell to $12.75-17.50 in the Northwest and $13.75-18.50 at COB.
